## Deliverables

Upon project completion, clients receive complete ownership of a production-ready web application:

- **Complete Source Code**: Full access to clean, documented repository code hosted on GitHub or client-specified Git infrastructure.
- **Production Web Application**: Deployed live application configured on client domain names with active SSL/TLS certificates and CDN edge caching.
- **Content Management System (CMS) / Admin Dashboard**: Configured administrative portal allowing staff to manage pages, articles, media, and user requests.
- **Technical Documentation**: Comprehensive developer documentation detailing project setup, build commands, component hierarchy, and environment variable requirements.
- **User Training & Onboarding Session**: Video recorded walkthrough and operational guide training client team members on updating content and managing system settings.
- **Deployment Configuration Files**: Docker containers, deployment scripts, and CI/CD workflow files for continuous integration and rapid updates.
